required_queries.scope: Every actual selected static model and each of its three inputs, under the same real context/core configuration; query errors retained.

minimal_measurable_next_candidate.packing: One small NEON kernel fusing CF FP32 transpose and conversion into a layout proved by actual native query; retain all input finite/overflow and byte/stride checks.
minimal_measurable_next_candidate.layout_acceptance: Initially only a fully proved dense FP16 layout. Do not infer native from command1, format label alone, or a legacy model. Reject unsupported or ambiguous blocked/padded layouts.
minimal_measurable_next_candidate.ownership: Buffer remains owned until synchronous run/get/output-copy/release finishes; no caller alias and no partial graph on any error.
minimal_measurable_next_candidate.output_transport: Keep original outputs_get(want_float1), owned canonical copy and release.

separate_zero_copy_scope: SDK-managed create_mem/set_io_mem with actual native attrs, CPU-to-device coherency/mem_sync where required, all DMA included in cache budget and destroy_mem before context teardown; no implementation or bypass flags added.
retained_boundary: Historical FP32 failure stays diagnostic/non-adopted; pass_through/layout equivalence needs an actual same-state SDK AB, not old trajectory gold.
